name: Miyaguni Akari
source:
Favorite food: Anmitsu 

The last princess and heir to the throne of the empire. After the empire’s defeat she hides her identity and vows to strike back at those who harmed her mother. Even though she might be of royal birth, she still shows plenty of her emotions. She has a habit of crying when she’s happy or sad.

[From [url=http://www.otakulair.com/news/japanese-visual-novels/character-images-for-sen-no-hatou-tsukisome-no-kouki-at-dengeki-hime/]Otaku Lair[/url]]

[spoiler]In her route, she reclaimed the empire as the 88th empress, Toukatei (桃花帝).[/spoiler]
